name: Run from Fast Fredbear
desc:
Welcome to Fredbear’s House, a place you were never supposed to enter. Fredbear moves insanely fast, and he knows every corner of his home better than you ever will.
He hears and sees.

Controls:
PC: Press F to call Fredbear. He will sprint insanely fast toward your location — use this to distract him or bait him away.
Left Shift to Sprint.

(THIS GAME IS STILL UNDER DEVELOPMENT. EXPECT BUGS!)
